'''Skali X-Wing Hidden Base''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Skali]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/XWingHiddenBase.htm X-Wing Hidden Base], The Outer Rim (Skali). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155336/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/XWingHiddenBase.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Skali]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''X-Wing Hidden Base''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]

== Introduction ==

Skali posted this Expanded Universe Hidden Base X-wing list on The Outer Rim.
